address: salita Cappuccini 4, Monterosso al Mare, 19016, Italy
bio: Just a few minutes' walk from the centre, slightly uphill, and from the indispensable public car park, we are in a restaurant in full marine style, literally clinging to the cliff, with a wall carved out of the living rock. From the upper terrace (reservation strongly recommended!) the view is breathtaking, while the cuisine, very generous and rich in ingredients, honours the sea without forgetting the land, as in the best Ligurian tradition. The dishes on the menu are updated daily with alternatives by voice or blackboard....
